Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a source-grounded raster sprite for a 2D side-view Silent Hill fighting game. Exactly ONE complete creature, full body, on genuinely transparent RGBA background. Detailed source-matching game texture with soft neutral light, no cinematic glow or broad shadow. No panels, second view, text, UI, floor, scenery, border, grid or watermark.
Character: Gum Head from the 2007 Silent Hill: The Arcade ONLY. Attached native model and two native gameplay frames define this exact version. Preserve its grey mottled stone-like leathery skin, tall smooth oval head with vague dark facial pits, thick neck, hunched shoulders, two long sinewy arms, two bent legs, humanlike hands and bare feet. Small irregular dark mottled patches run across the whole body; preserve that native gray color rather than making it brown, bloody or glossy. A slightly crouched forward-leaning right-facing ready stance; both arms held forward at distinct heights and both feet grounded, separated enough to read. Full head, both hands and all foot ends remain visible. Keep the indistinct smooth lower torso of the source, no added anatomical detail. No clothes, added armor, accessories or weapon. Specifically NO club, pipe, tree branch or other weapon from Silent Hill 4 Gum Heads. No extra limb, stretched mouth, giant fangs, claws, spikes, tail or invented body mutation. Maintain source proportions and identity; the composition is a new side-view pose of the Arcade creature.
rows.limits: Native Arcade model render plus two gameplay frames establish identity, mottled material and unarmed anatomy. Right-facing pose, occluded side and fine texture are reconstructed, not measured or fidelity-certified. Static idle candidate only.
